services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Nathan Becker
reviews.text: Good stuff! Proactively sought me out after they saw my distress photo on a local social media page. Charged what they said they would. Good humble operators. Will call again.

reviews.author: Jesse Andrews
reviews.text: They were super quick and friendly. I was able to make the call, get the car, and have the drive to the tire shop all within 30 minutes. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: EvansWS6
reviews.text: Justin from Got Your 6 did a fine job! Had issues after work with a dead vehicle and he showed up and got me hell pretty fast. Very respectful guy and knows his stuff! If you get him, know you will be fully taken care of! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Neil Mobley
reviews.text: Dispatch was very professional, pick up driver was very knowledgeable as well as professional the whole encounter was very fast and convenient I will definitely recommend and use them in the future.

reviews.author: Peter Csak
reviews.text: They were quick! Timmy was very kind and friendly and he get the job done like a family vibes amazing guy and work ethics.

reviews.author: Kim Smith
reviews.text: Tim ( the good looking Tim) just left my job with my car. Tim was very polite professional and courtesy. Unfortunately I have had dealings with this tow company many times. Every experience has been a positive experience.They treat your vehicle like it belongs to them. Their customer service skills and actual work performance is top notch.

reviews.author: Danielle J
reviews.text: Tim was great. I had a rental car that was “non-responsive “ I couldn’t even get inside it. Time was very precious as I was in my way to hospice to say goodbye to a loved one. Tim arrived way ahead of schedule, figured out that the battery was dead and got me going. He was kind, polite, professional and efficient. Thank you Tim. Thanks to you I got there in time.

reviews.author: Melissa Humphries
reviews.text: Tim was excellent. We were 4hrs away when our son (a student at HPU) called with truck issues. Tim towed my son’s vehicle, gave him a ride, and was so pleasant and made him feel comfortable. Will for sure use again if needed in the future! Thanks for awesome customer service!!!!!

reviews.author: Erica Williams
reviews.text: Thank you guys so much! They were at my location within 20 minutes. Very quick service! They accept cash and if you use a debit/cc they will provide a link you can pay online before services are rendered.

reviews.author: Mary Mata
reviews.text: Tim did an amazing job, this was the first time I’ve ever needed a tow and he made it totally effortless. He communicated with me the whole time and even got the job done a couple of hours before the estimated time of arrival. The only reason I needed to be there was to unlock the car to disengage the hand brake, he took care of the rest! He was super friendly and made me feel at ease. He was thorough and double checked to make sure my vehicle was being dropped off at the correct location. If you need a tow, do not hesitate to call these guys! You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Victoria Spencer
reviews.text: Tim Had to jump my work truck and he was great! Made my irritating day better with his lovely personality and a great humor! Had my truck up and running in less than 5 minutes! Thank you so much Tim! Would recommend and use again!

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.text: I called for service and they showed up in just minutes. The driver Tim was polite,professional and courteous. Price was reasonable, and will use the again if necessary. Thanks so much

reviews.author: Claudia
reviews.text: Nate was very helpful and friendly! Towing was fast and easy. I would recommend Got Your Towing to anybody who is in a situation similar.

reviews.author: Rileigh
reviews.text: Tim was very helpful, he got our work truck working in no time. He worked quickly and efficiently. He was also very kind, respectful, funny and he is wonderful at his job. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Lee Majorz
reviews.text: Great reliable company fast responding very professional and respectful. Nate was very nice and treated my car with care would definitely recommend to any and everyone to call them if your ever in a situation that you need help especially Nate. A1 company in my opinion.

reviews.author: Kevin Jackson
reviews.text: Son locked his keys in the car. From time I called to time they handed him they Keys was less than 30 minutes. Very impressed with their prompt service.

reviews.author: The Guardian Angel Initiative
reviews.text: I had assistance by Justin. My Father purchased his vehicle from TN and 4 days later the car in the process of shutting down while driving on the highway and I was able to get the vehicle and park it at Wendy’s a mile from my house. Justin was dispatched and responded immediately and brought my father’s car in less than 30 mins and was able to tell me the issue with the car! Thank you Justin.

reviews.author: Misa Knight
reviews.text: Spoke with Jeff whom took the info and set the appointment to come get the car. Justin showed up to get it. He got it on the flatbed truck to take to Firestone for us. Both where very friendly but professional. I was very comfortable with both and the handling of towing the car. Furthermore, I liked the fact it is a Veteran owned company since my dad was a 30 year Navy Veteran.

reviews.author: Natalie Fitzgerald
reviews.text: I was in a bad car accident and literally no ride but Tim took me home and helped me get my things out the car. He broke a sweat to help me lol but I appreciate all the help. He saved me a trip home and to the tow company. Thanks Tim keep up the good customer service

reviews.author: Curly Capricorn
reviews.text: This is by far the best tow company I’ve ever dealt with. The tow truck arrived within 20 minutes of my call to them. Tim, the driver was extremely kind and professional. Dispatch was also very pleasant. I also like the fact I could pay with card or cash and they send you a secure link to pay with a credit card. The rate was extremely reasonable. This will be the company my family uses moving forward. As daughter of a former marine, I love that they veteran owned. I highly recommend this company. Keep up the amazing service and thank you for your service!

reviews.author: China Blu
reviews.text: They came quick within 10 mins, the only place that picked up my phone call instead of sending me to VM. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dede Griffith
reviews.text: Scheduled for 10 am they came almost 2 hours early but it wasn't a loss because the garage was open I just wasn't dressed. The tower was very professional and nice.

reviews.author: Deitra Dobbins
reviews.text: My Jeep needed to be towed to my mechanic. Ashton, the driver, called and gave me his ETA and handled my tow so smooth and easy.

reviews.author: Dc Powell
reviews.text: Lee was a professional guy. He loaded my car with a flat tire up on his truck with no issue and unloaded it with no trouble. I highly recommend this tow company if you are ever in trouble.

reviews.author: Gary Smith
reviews.text: Had to call them on two separate times and was the fastest service I have ever gotten. They were quick fast and accurate. Exactly what you want when you are stranded. Super friendly . I would highly recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Cheryl McDowell
reviews.text: The drivers are very nice and respectful. I ended up having 2 tows in 2 days and everything was handled quickly and neatly. I honestly dont think i would ever use a different company.

reviews.author: Carlos Madrigal
reviews.text: Very happy with their service, fast service and reasonable price. I will definitely use them again if needed.

reviews.author: paxton workman
reviews.text: Great service, the car was too low when the driver arrived so he waited for me to get it raised up and he was able to get the car out of a tight spot, no damage.

reviews.author: Trenise M
reviews.text: Very quick response time in 90° heat, great customer service, knowledgeable and overall satisfaction. Would highly recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Bobbie DiPilato
reviews.text: These guys are the absolute best! Justin is so kind and made me feel comfortable even though I was stressed over my car having to be towed!

reviews.author: Graham
reviews.text: Nate literally came to our rescue. We broke down 4 hours from home and he over delivered with great service, hospitality and even recommended near by hotels and mechanics in the area. Thanks, Nate!

reviews.author: Vetroni Mcdonald
reviews.text: Best tow company in thomasville. Responses swiftly to calls and very personable. Ask for justin he'll teach you something.

reviews.author: Joshua Herbert
reviews.text: Service was outstanding, super quick and professional. Justin was helpful, polite and extremely fair with pricing!

reviews.author: brownsugadeb
reviews.text: The owner of this company was AMAZING. Super professional, friendly, prompt, very informative & knowledgeable. I hope to never need a tow again but if so they will receive my business

reviews.author: Kelly Isley
reviews.text: Great and reliable company! My driver Nate was very efficient and quick! In the future if needed, I will be using this company again and recommending others to do so!

reviews.author: casey guy
reviews.text: I hope I never need them again but i definitely would...excellent fast very professional couldn't ask for more... had an accident on Christmas day and was back at home in 40 min including police reports... fastest turn time I've ever heard of... 10/10

reviews.author: Jenny Kiaosouvath
reviews.text: I’ve called this company twice and they have been so quick and kind to get the car where it needed to be. It truly felt like the whole process would take less than 30 minutes. It was a very reasonable price too!

reviews.author: Jessica Douthit
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Timothy was very nice and did a great job! I will be calling this place for any future towing needs and will recommend them to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Living Life
reviews.text: This company was dispatched by Good Sam. The tow company was nice exceptionally friendly. They took very good care of my vehicle. The office people were exceptionally nice. They scheduled a time to pick my vehicle up. They called to make sure everything was OK. Great service would recommend them

reviews.author: Brittany Proctor
reviews.text: Awesome group of guys to work with. They always get tows to me in a timely manner. Can’t beat their prices and trust me I have called around. If you need a tow these are the guys you want to call!

reviews.author: Lynanne Madden
reviews.text: The tow truck driver was very nice and easy to understand. He was efficient and timely. I’m very appreciative of him.

reviews.author: Amber Vandenberghe
reviews.text: This was the first time I ever needed a tow and they made it painless ! Super friendly and handled everything with professionalism. Although I wish to never need a tow again, if I do I will be using them!

reviews.author: Willie Hunter
reviews.text: These guys are great. Professional timely and understanding and non judgmental about how you go stuck. Seriously will use them again.

reviews.author: Imani Smith
reviews.text: Tim was amazing and made the entire towing process seamless. He was helpful, reassuring, and had a great sense of humor. I would absolutely recommend him and this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Olivia Ames
reviews.text: College kid who’s broke down in a restaurant parking lot, couldnt get it to start. My dad called from out of state and had a driver to me within 30 minutes exactly. Timothy was very helpful and friendly. He saw how stressed I was and worked efficiently to get me out of there as soon as possible. The dispatcher was very helpful in regards to my situation and worked with my dad to coordinate things. I’ve worked for a towing company myself and have never seen a tow done so fast and smoothly. And to be on a Sunday night, the price was extremely respectable and affordable. I would definitely recommend them!!

reviews.author: Tanya McCoy
reviews.text: Great affordable prompt service! Called and they were to us in a half hour. Driver was very friendly!

reviews.author: Paige Brazil
reviews.text: Arrived within the 25 minutes given for pick up. Respectable, nice. Did not over charge me because it was a Sunday. Price was cheaper than the other 5 tow companies I called. Will continue to use for any future needs.

reviews.author: Daniel Johnson
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, affordable. My clutch gave out today. Found this company on Google, with great reviews. Lee arrived 30 minutes later, hooked my jeep up, and towed it to my house. Very friendly, very down to earth. Will use if I ever need a tow again

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.text: Had an awful accident. These guys cleaned up my mess and babysat my vehicle until the insurance company decided what they wanted to do with it! These guys were polite and let me come in and out to get my belongings. They helped me take my tag off and helped make light of the situation. If I ever need some towing in the future “never again for a wreck” I will for sure contact these guys to get the job done!! Thanks again

reviews.author: Kingston Reviews
reviews.text: Justin ,thanks for coming to pull our son's car out of the mud. Really appreciate how quick and professional you were.

reviews.author: Bev Brown
reviews.text: A+++++!!!!! Highly recommend this towing company! Contacted Roadside Assistance & received the tow truck, all in less than 45 minutes! The tow truck driver was professional and prompt! Thank you Sir, for a job well done! Very much appreciated!

reviews.author: Kim Patterson
reviews.text: Not sure what type of scam this company has with High Point PD. My daughter was invloved in a traffic accident and instead of allowing her to use our AAA plan to tow the car home it was towed to this lot. I was told the lot would open at 8am. I arrived at 8:05 and nobody was there. At 8:30 a gentleman arrived but he did not have the key to open the gate. At 8:45 another gentleman arrived with the key. When I asked could I get a little bit of a discount for waiting 40mins I was laughed at. They had the vehicle for less than 12hrs cost me $295. Shame on you.

reviews.author: Courtney Field
reviews.text: Got stuck in the snow - Tim was quick, professional and made the whole process easy. Very appreciative.

reviews.author: Anita Williams
reviews.text: I caught a flat on the highway. The driver reached me quickly and was very friendly and professional! He got the car on the truck bed quickly and efficiently! If you need assistance I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: kevin turner
reviews.text: There customer service is outstanding. Dispatch was upfront with the price of my tow. There were constant text and a call from the driver to let me know exact time of arrival. I would not call anyone else if I was in need of a tow agian in the future.

reviews.author: Emmeline Dixon
reviews.text: They got to me quick and thankfully tried jumping my car before towing it! We had tried jumping it with cables but they had a box for it and got it running. Saved us $20. The only bad part was still paying $78 for him to come out, jump the car, and leave. Dylan gave some good advice while he was here at least! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Amanda Gotay
reviews.text: Unfortunately, my Son and his father were in a car accident and my SUV was totaled, but thank God they are OK. As any Mom would feel, I was in panic and overwhelmed with the whole situation arriving on the scene. I do not know the actual tow truck drivers name but he remained professional despite my disposition. The next day I was still all over the place and went to the wrong tow truck lot but eventually found where my vehicle was located. Tow truck companies tend to get a bad rep and can be known for having a nonchalant demeanor when it comes to dealing with someone’s personal assets and belongings. BUT, Got Your 6 Towing & Recovery was not like this at all. Tim (the good looking one not the short one lol) was super helpful and a gentleman when it came to helping me clean out my truck. Even the gentleman I spoke with on the phone. Thank you guys for being so professional during a vulnerable time. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Amber White
reviews.text: Ashton was super nice and helpful, he made me feel comfortable and was very efficient with his time and my own! It was also a reasonable price for the distance!

reviews.author: Ebony Casey
reviews.text: I appreciate how fast you were able to respond to my request today. Tow truck arrived within 20 minutes of my call. I highly recommend using their service. Payment was quick and easy. Thanks for all your help today. Really a lifesaver.

reviews.author: Frank Crociata
reviews.text: My daughter is just starting at High Point University. She dropped me off at the airport on the way home for car broke down. These guys were amazing there within 20 minutes. Make sure she was safe.

reviews.author: Jimmy & Peggy Isley
reviews.text: We got a call that our son had hydroplaned off of the road and was stuck. It was 9:45 at night dark and raining, he was shook up. I called Got Your 6 Towing & Recovery. From the first phone call with dispatch to talking with the driver Jason and my son pulling in the driveway at home. They were fantastic! I was impressed and I don’t say that often! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Stephanie Sala
reviews.text: I called my Life360 Roadside Assistance at 10:10 and was quoted that my car would be picked up between 11:50-12:20. At 10:45, my car was loaded up and heading to the mechanic. Got Your 6 came right away and got me taken care of. 10/10 would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Charlene Cheek
reviews.text: They are awesome. My tow guy was cool as heck and super personable. He made sure I got home safely and was courteous. A++

reviews.author: Katrina Jeen
reviews.text: At Your 6 came and helped me close to midnight to accommodated my tow. They were fast and professional. So much so I called them again 2 days later to tow me again to the mechanics shop. Great professional and fast service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: lenora
reviews.text: They have helped me out of a jam twice in two weeks. Very nice to deal with. I would definitely refer them to others.

reviews.author: Cody Locklear
reviews.text: Went to pick my car up. Seems like the owner lives in a camper on the property. Called while I was there and he would never come out of his camper. When he finally did the man said he was going to charge me triple for waking him up and if I did not pay it then I would not be able to get my car back. Be careful with this company.

reviews.author: cristian vargas
reviews.text: Picked up a clients car and all of a sudden the good battery that was in the car is gone and replaced with a bad one. Wonder what happened to the good battery ….. could’ve atleast bolted the battery back up

reviews.author: Ernest Bowie
reviews.text: This was the 4th or 5th time they have towed a vehicle for me. They provided great and fast service, like always. They are always extremely respectful, polite and professional. Would 100% recomend them to anyone who may need their services!!!

reviews.author: Alexia Brockington
reviews.text: Great service and even with my car issues they helped me solve it with no hassle and got the job done perfectly 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Terri Montes
reviews.text: Ashton was great! The service was quick and he got us back on the road safely! 10 out of 10 recommend!

reviews.author: Gracie Heltzman
reviews.text: I needed to get my car towed and they were awesome!! i had a great experience with this company!!! Ashton was amazing. Definitely get your car towed through them

reviews.author: GARLAND “GROUTH83” Routh
reviews.text: Starter went out and they picked me up and putting part on. Very kind and thankful for their service.

reviews.author: Candace
reviews.text: I spent a lot of time calling to get quotes on towing prices and they were the most budget friendly which I appreciate ! Along with being kind to the wallet they were also friendly and efficient! I’ve had to deal with many tow companies/drivers since owning this vehicle and they are by far the best I’ve dealt with. And if I ever get a vehicle again and need a tow? Got your 6 is who I will call and if I know of anyone that needs a tow? I am recommending Got your six to them! Thank you for helping make this rough car experience a lot easier ! I really do appreciate it

reviews.author: Melodie Dugum
reviews.text: Justin was fantastic! It's so cold outside and he came quickly and was very efficient in the process of moving things along. My daughter's car was in a very awkward location and I knew he had his work cut out for him. Thank you so much for the best experience possible in a vad situation.

reviews.author: Jansen Compton
reviews.text: Trevor was Extremely professional. On point with his service. Very respectful. Told me he would be there in 30 min and was in fact there in 30 min. Would not hesitate to recommend their services to someone else

reviews.author: Christina Gaylor
reviews.text: Ashton was very sweet! He came quickly and allowed me to ride to the destination with no hesitation!! Thank you Ashton for being kind

reviews.author: TR Harris Jr
reviews.text: Pick was quicker than estimated. Driver was very courteous & helpful. He got me towed to the auto shop w/o any issues. Thank you again for your service & thank you VZ Roadside assistance. TR Harris

reviews.author: drifty
reviews.text: Jason of Got Your 6 Towing was extremely polite and professional. He showed up quickly, explained what has likely happened to my tire, and offered to drop me off at my house on his way to leave my car for a new tire. I rarely leave reviews but I wanted to show my appreciation for a person and company that goes beyond what is necessary to help people when they need it most.

reviews.author: Ronald Vergantino
reviews.text: They are very respectful people very prompt as well. If not loaded down with work the guy who come to get my fiancé‘s car was very respectful very nice. I would definitely use them 1 million times over and I love the fact that they veteran because I come from a very big veteran family, and I’m really appreciative

reviews.author: Quitta J
reviews.text: My sister had a flat on the highway and Progressive sent this company. The driver (Tim) got there within 10 minutes and had her hooked up before i got there. I only had a 16 min drive to her. He towed her to a tire place that happened to still be open after 9pm and was done uploading her all in less than an hour. Will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: Lekresha Mitchell
reviews.text: The guy who came to help me was nothing but amazing. He arrived quickly and was super nice. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Anthony Wilson III
reviews.text: Called for a Lock Out service on a family members car. Real friendly, professional and they made it to my location quickly. Highly recommend if you need quick service. Not sure about the price because they were sent to me by a third party without charge.

reviews.author: Thomasine Williams
reviews.text: Driver did an awesome job. He was very courteous, and very attentive to what I needed. I would recommend them to anyone. Great company to do business with.

reviews.author: Mandi Grant
reviews.text: Called because the alternator went out in my car. Less then 5 minutes from calling the car was being picked up. The fastest service ever!!! The driver was absolutely amazing to deal with. Highly recommend Got Your 6 Towing & Recovery

reviews.author: Heather Richardson
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, affordable service and customer service. My son wrecked his vehicle, my emotions was already all over the place and I definitely appreciate the kindness of the dispatcher and driver. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Srinidhi Tuppal
reviews.text: Very professional and reliable service. They were polite and kept updating us on their ETA when our car broke down and we were in the middle of an high way. The service was very fast and smooth. Would highly recommend anyone needing towing services. They definitely got your back!

reviews.author: 2ndGenRamNC
reviews.text: I need more stars for them! Owner is a great guy! The driver that picked me up was super respectful and knowledgeable. He talked how good the company takes care of the guys and how much he loves his job. You definitely know your gonna get a good service in that mix. I highly recommend "Got your 6"!

reviews.author: Aaron Soto
reviews.text: Quick, easy, and efficient. They had our vehicle picked up and dropped off within the hour. Very communicative every step of the way. 10/10 recommend Got Your 6 Towing for all your roadside needs

reviews.author: Jimmy Ford
reviews.text: These guys are awesome to deal with! Fast and accurate. God forbid I break down, but I'll definitely call them again!

reviews.author: Peggy Adkins

reviews.author: Vonder Ashford

reviews.author: Tony Dickens-Gibbs

reviews.author: Bruce Paulk
reviews.text: Arrived quickly and got the car to the destination with no issues. Friendly and considerate driver Timothy.

reviews.author: BklynBajan Boy

reviews.author: Kandace Perryman

reviews.author: William Harris

reviews.author: Robin Wray

reviews.author: Jeffrey Smith

reviews.author: Stacy Jones
reviews.text: My family has called them several times and they are the only people we will call for help. They are so kind and helpful, every time.

reviews.author: Rachel Sinclair
reviews.text: On 9/8/2022 I needed a tow and after calling my roadside assistant. I was real surprised how quick got your 6 towing responded. He was very professional and I received A+ service. Will recommend them for any towing!!! Thank you Got your 6 towing!!!

reviews.author: James Kirkman
reviews.text: Driver was prompt and professional. Responded quickly and got the vehicle home before Allstate said they would show up. Great job by towing service.

reviews.author: Debbi Gottesman
reviews.text: This company was super with timing. The driver Justin was competent and careful with handling my vehicle as well as friendly.. The service I received was great.. thanx for your help..

reviews.author: Bloorp Bloorp
reviews.text: quick response, got here earlier then the estimated time and a good price for the distance and the driver was friendly.

reviews.author: Angel Salazar
reviews.text: True Professionals, Showed up and handled business and did it with a smile, would highly recommend and to top it off very affordable! Shout out to Justin true gentleman!

reviews.author: Bobby Patel
reviews.text: Great tow company! Very nice people - helped me in a tough situation and i am sure they will continue to help others with tow needs. Highly recommend!!!
